decisions.reason: Connector-placement flexibility does not change BOM readiness, component sourcing, population, or justification requirements.
The placement decision does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, rail role, or Schottky-drop compensation.
The source permits general connector placement but does not change the required panel-control connector inventory, signals, or external mounting policy.
The charge-status interface remains required with the same connector and electrical properties; no candidate attribute specifies a conflicting board-edge location.
The source does not change the integrated-board location, connector type, PWRON signal, mounting, or control behavior of the panel power button.
General connector placement does not alter the monitored rails, monitor device, measurement position, coverage, or unresolved INA omission question.
